Standard.Name: Move Council member to town hall

English.Text: Elder Selassy'e opposes my every proposal! He must certainly have some nefarious plan— I ask you to follow him!
Nothing... strange. There is more to this, I am sure of it!
There he is! Follow him— it shouldn't be hard to catch him red-handed!
Keep your eyes peeled for any secret signals he might be giving.
Keep watching his hands— perhaps he will pocket something!
Elder Tebibi wishes to uncover the vices of Selassy'e to stop him always undermining her at the Moot.
The Elder is surprised no compromising evidence was found and swears to dig deeper.

Elder Tebibi wishes you to help shed light on the hidden vices of her strongest opponent in the Moot: Elder Selassy'e. She is sure he is up to something, and even if he isn't, she can't afford for him to sabotage her career first.
Elder Selassy'e usually starts his day at the Trading Post before going to the Marketplace.
Select Selassy'e to start tailing him
The Elder is certain tailing Selassy'e will uncover his sinful behaviour.
The Elder suspects bribery— or worse— may be afoot, but lacks evidence.
Keep an eye on Selassy'e as he roams the city
The Elder has mounting suspicions that Selassy'e is about to commit a misdeed.
